T o date, however , we’ve lacked information on how these usage patterns map onto people’ s thoughts and impressions of AI. Our recent survey study with 81,000 Claude users provides a way to connect people’ s economic concerns with what we’ve quantified in Claude traffic. The survey asked people about their visions and fears around advances in AI. Many of the thoughts that people shared touched on economic topics. W e learned that many people fear job displacement—though they also feel more productive and empowered at work.
